name: Jahonotin Uvaysiy
contribution: A Sufi poet from Margilon in the Ferghana Valley in Uzbekistan.
legacy: She produced over 15,000 hemistiches of verse and it is still popular in Uzbekistan today.

checks.lead: Jahonotin Uvaysiy (1780–1845) was a Sufi poet from Margilon in the Ferghana Valley in Uzbekistan. She was an Otin-Oys, an Uzbek religious woman held in great esteem.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
